sources.title: mancer - models
sources.snippet: The LLaMA v2 fine-tune that everyone's been raving about, extended to 8k for your prompting pleasure. Utterly unfiltered, rich descriptions, and unexpectedly good output. Use the Alpaca instruct-prompt for best effect. Parameters should focus on Top-P instead of Top-K. Sometimes needs a high Rep.Pen. to get kicked out of a rut. Click for model source.
